subject: Re: GED-TTS status: repulsive term is load-bearing
body:
Team,

Decisions for the production run:

1. Config locks Jul 2: multi-scale repulsive term on, same-speaker batching, Jorge's utterance-length curriculum included — the long-utterance gap closed to noise in the last test.
2. The run executes in our vulcan-h100 week starting Jul 6 on the 512-accelerator reservation: main model plus the two ablations, nothing else rides along.
3. MOS panel is booked for Jul 27; if we match the released MOS 4.25 on internal voices, Chiara starts serving integration in August.

Scope cut: vocoder-variant ablations are out; the energy-distance model is the story.

Goran
